original.text: dhammo vatthusahāvo khamādibhāvo ya dasaviho dhammo / rayaṇattayaṃ ca dhammo jīvāṇaṃ rakkhaṇaṃ dhammo
original.edition: recalled by the unit author (wording believed standard; to be checked against an edition)

paraphrase: Dharma is the nature of a thing; dharma is the tenfold [virtue] beginning with forbearance; dharma is the three jewels; dharma is the protection of living beings.
notes: Verse number recalled, not checked; the content is the unit author's recollection (skeleton).

paraphrase: In the reflection on the universe the text describes the uncreated, beginningless world of six substances in the shape of a standing man, with the hells below, the middle world and the heavens above, and the abode of the liberated at the summit.
